description: Issue #182 (1), the measured case: three issues with ZERO cross-reference, whose only connection is vocabulary. `cmate` comes from the prose "cmate-verify の全ゲート" in an acceptance criterion, `data` and `page` from path fragments each issue cites under `## 参考` about the OTHER one — and no two of them name a file in common. 0.27.0 built three inferred edges out of that and serialised the three into three waves; two thirds of the wall-clock was spent waiting on word choice. A lexical-only inference is now a question on the consumer instead of an edge, so all three share one wave and a human is asked to confirm or state the dependency. The question is what stops dispatch: `warnings` alone would not, and the run before this change was a clean `success`.
